title: Full-flow staged-combustion engine
description: Two preburners, one fuel-rich and one oxygen-rich, so all of both propellants pass through a turbine and reach the main chamber as hot gas. Each turbine runs cooler for the same power, and nothing is wasted.

derived.note: throat from nozzle diameter and expansion ratio

reference.note: Length, nozzle diameter and expansion ratio match the published figures. Little else is published, so the internal layout is representative.

flow_model.note: Streak speed follows local flow speed on a compressed scale: display speed = 0.22 * v^0.32 (m/s).

liquids_ms.note: nominal values, not from engine data

preburner_gas_ms.note: nominal values, not from engine data

parts.title: Thrust mount
parts.description: Bolts the engine to the vehicle and carries the thrust load into the structure.

parts.title: Gimbal joint
parts.description: Two-axis universal joint. Lets the whole engine swivel so the thrust vector can steer the vehicle.

parts.title: Thrust adapter
parts.description: Transfers thrust from the top of the oxidizer turbopump into the gimbal.

parts.title: Oxidizer pump
parts.description: Raises all of the liquid oxygen to far above chamber pressure. On this engine the whole oxidizer turbopump sits on the engine's own axis, above the injector.

parts.title: Oxygen-rich preburner
parts.description: Burns nearly all of the oxygen with a little fuel. The result is hot, oxygen-rich gas, which is what makes this cycle 'full flow'.

parts.title: Oxidizer pump turbine
parts.description: Driven by the oxygen-rich gas, which then flows straight down into the injector.

parts.title: Oxidizer turbopump rotor
parts.description: Pump impeller at the top, turbine wheel at the bottom. Both sides handle oxygen, so a leak along the shaft is harmless.

parts.title: Dome bolts
parts.description: Clamp the oxidizer dome onto the injector assembly.

parts.title: Oxidizer gas dome
parts.description: Spreads the oxygen-rich gas from the turbine over the tops of the injector posts.

parts.title: Fuel gas manifold
parts.description: Takes the fuel-rich gas from the fuel turbine and leads it around the injector posts.

parts.title: Gas-gas injector
parts.description: Both propellants arrive as hot gas: oxygen-rich down the posts, fuel-rich around them. Gas mixes and burns faster than liquid, so the chamber can be short.

parts.title: Chamber liner
parts.description: Copper-alloy inner wall. Liquid methane runs through the channels milled into its outside and keeps it from melting.

parts.title: Coolant outlet manifold
parts.description: Collects the methane after it has cooled the nozzle and chamber, and sends it on to the preburners.

parts.title: Chamber jacket
parts.description: Outer shell that closes the coolant channels and holds the chamber pressure: 300 bar, the highest of any engine in service.

parts.title: Nozzle joint bolts
parts.description: Fasten the nozzle to the chamber exit flange.

parts.title: Coolant inlet manifold
parts.description: Ring low on the nozzle. High-pressure methane from the pump enters here and spreads into the wall.

parts.title: Nozzle
parts.description: Expands the exhaust to high speed. Its wall is cooled by the methane on its way up to the chamber.

parts.title: Fuel-rich preburner
parts.description: Burns nearly all of the methane with a little oxygen. The fuel-rich gas drives the fuel pump's turbine.

parts.title: Fuel pump turbine
parts.description: Driven by the fuel-rich gas, which then flows through the side duct into the injector.

parts.title: Fuel pump
parts.description: Two centrifugal stages raise the liquid methane to far above chamber pressure.

parts.title: Fuel turbopump rotor
parts.description: Turbine wheels at the top, pump impellers below. Both sides handle fuel, so here too a shaft leak is harmless.

parts.title: Main fuel valve
parts.description: Opens to send high-pressure methane to the cooling circuit.

parts.title: Main oxidizer valve
parts.description: Opens to send high-pressure oxygen to the oxygen-rich preburner.

parts.title: High-pressure oxidizer line
parts.description: Carries liquid oxygen from the pump to the oxygen-rich preburner.

parts.title: Preburner oxidizer line
parts.description: Sends a small share of the oxygen to the fuel-rich preburner.

parts.title: Coolant feed line
parts.description: Carries methane from the pump down the outside of the nozzle to the inlet manifold.

parts.title: Preburner fuel line
parts.description: Carries the warmed methane from the coolant outlet manifold to the fuel-rich preburner.

parts.title: Preburner fuel tap
parts.description: Sends a small share of the methane to the oxygen-rich preburner.

parts.title: Gimbal actuator
parts.description: Linear actuator that tilts the engine. The two actuators sit 90 degrees apart.

parts.title: Gimbal actuator
parts.description: Linear actuator that tilts the engine. The two actuators sit 90 degrees apart.

parts.title: Fuel feed line
parts.description: Low-pressure liquid methane from the tank to the pump inlet.

parts.title: Oxidizer feed line
parts.description: Low-pressure liquid oxygen from the tank to the pump inlet.

parts.title: Fuel tank
parts.description: Liquid methane. Only lightly pressurised, because the pumps do the work. Shown schematically, not to scale.

parts.title: Oxidizer tank
parts.description: Liquid oxygen. Only lightly pressurised, because the pumps do the work. Shown schematically, not to scale.
